divergence: Mixed (T1 passes; T0 and T2 fail). All three runs surfaced the needed matter in their scans or path searches, and every review at the reading stages flagged hand-picked candidate sets. They split at the choice of what to read. T1 acted on those flags with store-wide widening steps it declared as new stages (an indicator extraction over every scan matter, then an exact-language scan), which brought later-dated candidates forward; it listed and read the needed matter and cited its disclosure cover letter. T0 read the four latest-numbered candidates from its scan summary and their siblings, ranked them in a reviewer-suggested stage with no tool calls, and named an earlier-closed investigation. T2's scans timed out; it read candidates picked from path searches, widened only by another path sweep, and named an earlier investigation. The reviews did not differ in kind; only T1 widened beyond its existing candidate set.
